تعليمات للنموذج الذكي (LLM):
قم بملء النموذج أدناه. استبدل جميع العلامات `[ ... ]` أو المساحات الفارغة بمحتوى المشروع ذي الصلة. استخدم `parameters.md` كمرجع.

الاسم.guidance: Stakeholder’s name. If you don’t have a name you can substitute a position or organization until you have more information

Position/Role.guidance: The position and/or role the stakeholder holds in the organization. Examples of positions include programmer, human resources analyst, or quality assurance specialist. Roles indicate the function the stakeholder performs on the project team, such as testing lead, Scrum Master, or scheduler

Contact information.guidance: How to communicate with the stakeholder, such as their phone number, email address, or physical address

المتطلبات.guidance: High-level needs for the project and/or product

Expectations.guidance: Main expectations of the project and/or product

Classification.guidance: Some projects may categorize stakeholders as friend, foe, or neutral; others may classify them as high, medium, or low impact
